about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Vicente Gonzalez

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RELIABLE WATER FOR CORPUS CHRISTI
statements.title: RELIABLE WATER FOR CORPUS CHRISTI
sentences: He then went on to say to the people of Corpus Christi: We are going to take care of it.
Today, I am asking him to keep that promise, and I urge you to ensure that he does.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: VISAS FOR SHRIMPERS
statements.title: VISAS FOR SHRIMPERS
sentences: I strongly urge President Trump and this administration to release more H-2B or H-2A visas so we can bring certainty to the coastal communities and ensure the American shrimping and fishing industry can survive. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEFENDING AMERICAN PROPERTY ABROAD ACT OF 2026
statements.title: DEFENDING AMERICAN PROPERTY ABROAD ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mexico's ongoing efforts to control a deep-water port owned by U.S.- based Vulcan Material Company not only puts American jobs at risk, but it is a direct violation of the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA).
I urge my colleagues to join me in supporting the Defending American Property Abroad Act.
With this bill, we will reinforce the rule of law, protect our supply chains, and assure that American businesses continue to create jobs and grow our economy. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXPRESSING GRATITUDE TO THE CITY OF BROWNSVILLE'S ENGINEERING AND PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT FOR THEIR SERVICE TO OUR COMMUNITY
statements.title: EXPRESSING GRATITUDE TO THE CITY OF BROWNSVILLE'S ENGINEERING AND PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT FOR THEIR SERVICE TO OUR COMMUNITY
sentences: The Brownsville Police Department served more than 600 hot meals to affected families at Laureles County Park.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DON'T CALL IT BEAUTIFUL
statements.title: DON'T CALL IT BEAUTIFUL
sentences: It wrapped its cruelty in buzz words like ``efficiency,'' ``modernization,'' and ``fiscal responsibility.'' However, beneath the surface, it is a cold and calculated attempt to strip millions of Americans of the dignity they have earned over a lifetime of work.
All of this was done at the behest of their master, their master who wants tax breaks for the ultra-wealthy billionaires and multinational corporations, with empty slogans for the rest of Americans.
We hear you, and we will not stop fighting. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WIPING OUT HISTORY
statements.title: WIPING OUT HISTORY
sentences: This administration's appalling efforts to erase history under the disguise of eliminating DEI has seen no boundaries, prompting indiscriminate removals of Latinos, women, and other minorities from our Nation's archives.
This is not about eliminating DEI.
